notes.title: VOICELINE UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello,



After several weeks, the voiceline update is finally available!



The main character is played by GodDoubleDamnit. Happy birthday to him!



Other minor changes:

Optimized the "SPAM E" menu

Changed the volume of some sounds



I haven't been very consistent lately, and I apologize for that. I'm working on the biggest project of my entire career, and it's taking up a lot of my time, but you'll hear about it soon on my Discord!



See you soon!

TheCourget

notes.title: VOICELINE UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello everyone !



In a few weeks, I am going to redo all the voicelines, and add missing ones.

The voices will now be in French, my voice actors are French, the quality will be better !



I'm redoing dialogues for several reasons:

Quality

I've cut ties with the voice actor "I", I won't say more on the subject for the moment.

The diversity of characters I could add (me, mom, dad, the doctor, etc.)

AI is a poor alternative



The update should be available in a few weeks.



I will show the progress on my official Discord, that you can join below !



Thank you for reading this,

TheCourget

notes.title: Improve SCHIZOPHRENIA with Me !
notes.content:
Hello everyone !

I want to announce that I'm going to try to improve SCHIZOPHRENIA as much as possible, and I'll do it with YOU.

If you'd like to become a beta tester for SCHIZOPHRENIA and future games, here's what you need to do:

- Join the Discord (link below this post)
- Go to #announcements
- Click on the Beta Tester Google Form link
- Fill out the form and submit it

You can improve SCHIZOPHRENIA, the upcoming ARG, and future games with me !

You'll find more information on the beta testing form on the Discord server.

Thank you, I appreciate your interest in SCHIZOPHRENIA,
TheCourget.

notes.title: Steam Achievements Update !
notes.content:
Hello,

Steam achievements are now present in SCHIZOPHRENIA.

There is some simple achievements, and some hidden easter eggs.

SOS.

TheCourget.

notes.content:
- Fixed a graphics issue
- You can now pause the game with the controller pause button, and B (for Xbox Controllers)

notes.content: - Fixed an issue with controller deadzone

notes.title: Controller Support Update Available !
notes.content:
Hello, everyone.

I'm proud to announce that you can now play SCHIZOPHRENIA with a Xbox controller,
from the main menu to the game ending.

It took a few days but it's now here !

I also fixed some small things.

Next update should be audio update or Steam achievements update.

I hope you'll like to play SCHIZOPHRENIA with a controller.

Note : PlayStation controller support is not planned for now.

Thank you for playing SCHIZOPHRENIA,
TheCourget.

notes.title: Controller Support Update Coming Soon.
notes.content:
Hello everyone !

I'm actually trying to release SCHIZOPHRENIA on consoles, but for now this is only an idea.
However, I think it can be cool to play SCHIZOPHRENIA with a controller.

The update should be uploaded in the week.

You can find more informations on the Discord server (link available in the game main menu or Steam page), there are also sneak peeks of a future project.

Thank you for playing SCHIZOPHRENIA,
TheCourget.

notes.title: Informations about SCHIZOPHRENIA.
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Firstly,
Thank you.
I've seen a lot of videos of SCHIZOPHRENIA on social medias like YouTube, and it's crazy.

Secondly,
I've seen people complaining about stereotypes.
Yes,
SCHIZOPHRENIA is based on stereotypes and it does not reflect reality.
I'm sorry for this misunderstanding, so, an update is coming in a few days, to add a section in the main menu, to provide documentation and redirect to sites that will fully explain schizophrenia.

Thirdly, the game will fix and add many things in a future update, as :

- Remaking the second flashback
- Fixing crosshair glitches
- Fixing softlocking with the kitchen trash
- Optimizing the game
- Fixing some more stuff

Thank you,
TheCourget

And remember, Attman was WRONG.
